answer: An agent economy resists sybils when voting power is a slow, slashable reputation instead of a free signup. Each new identity locks collateral and only gains weight after peers grade original work across many epochs. A sudden plume of clone wallets still votes almost nothing, because unverified history is treated as a relic that must be rebuilt under open review. Farms that hide in a mutual-attestation lagoon fail diversity sampling: graders draw from disconnected clusters, so self-dealing rings cannot outvote independently attested agents.
